description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03 as d49562986, three-lane re-audited PASS/PASS/PASS after a FAIL-and-rework where the guard caught a real push). The pull-only invariant is now a RUNNING MACHINE-CHECK, not a manual vigil. WorkStartReason tags every agenda enqueue (sanctioned: ChangedRevisionWake/StandingRootFrontier/ActivationFrontier/BlockedWaiterExpansion + external Ignition; else Unclassified by default). Scheduler tallies per-reason + root_scans; PullSession emits on pull.session.finished; 5-fixture corpus test asserts ignition==<external count> && unsanctioned_work_starts==0 && root_scans==0. NON-VACUOUS: a new enqueue added without a reason defaults to Unclassified -> trips RED (mutation-verified independently at two sites, 43-137 unsanctioned). HONEST BOUNDARY (documented in telemetry.md): catches UNTAGGED enqueues automatically; does NOT catch a deliberately-MISLABELED push (the ignition==N assertion is the specific backstop for the front-door-mislabel class). Behavior-neutral tagging (job counts byte-identical for the tag itself). At fold: hoisted record_work_starts 4->1 into the shared drive_root_backend_product; deleted 2 dead PullSession getters; stripped ticket-IDs from telemetry.md (docs law). THE GUARD PAID FOR ITSELF ON ITS FIRST RUN — see fz-go4.41, the ensure_runtime_module push it caught, eliminated in this same commit.
title: Implement the pull-session follow_ups==0 / root_scans==0 telemetry invariant (machine-check pull-only)
